meta.name: ASGARDEX Desktop
meta.description: Cross-chain DeFi wallet (Electron + React + TypeScript) for THORChain, MAYAChain, Chainflip, and OneClick across 17+ blockchains. Supports Keystore, Ledger, and Vultisig MPC wallet modes.

stateManagement.async: RemoteData (Initial | Pending | Failure | Success) + LiveData = Observable<RemoteData>
stateManagement.secondaryRedux: Redux Toolkit slices for aggregator, app UI prefs, gecko prices only

processModel.main: src/main/ — system, Ledger USB, Vultisig SDK, file storage, IPC handlers
processModel.renderer: src/renderer/ — all UI, business logic, chain services
processModel.shared: src/shared/ — types, IPC codecs, chain constants

maintenance.rule: Update this JSON and the HTML embedded DATA when structural architecture changes (new chain, wallet mode, protocol, IPC surface, or documented flow). Skip pure bugfixes/i18n/styling. Validate all edge and flow nodeIds exist.

nodes.label: Electron Main Process
nodes.tooltip: App lifecycle, BrowserWindow, menus, IPC registration, native integrations (Ledger HID, Vultisig SDK, filesystem).

nodes.label: Preload Bridge
nodes.tooltip: contextBridge exposes typed APIs on window (apiKeystore, apiHDWallet, apiMpc, storage, etc.). Renderer never imports main code directly.

nodes.label: Renderer (React App)
nodes.tooltip: React SPA: views, services, hooks, contexts. All DeFi business logic lives here.

nodes.label: Shared Types & Utils
nodes.tooltip: IPC message types, io-ts codecs (BigInt-safe), wallet types, chain constants, derivation paths shared by main and renderer.

nodes.label: Keystore API
nodes.tooltip: Load/save encrypted keystore wallets to disk (wallets.json).

nodes.label: Ledger API
nodes.tooltip: USB HID transport; per-chain address derivation and transaction signing for hardware wallets.

nodes.label: MPC / Vultisig API
nodes.tooltip: Main-process-only Vultisig SDK lifecycle: vault create/import, addresses, balances, multi-party signing. Never import SDK in renderer.

nodes.label: File Store API
nodes.tooltip: Persisted JSON stores: common, userNodes, userBondProviders, userChains, userAddresses, userAssets, pools, ledgers.

nodes.label: App Update API
nodes.tooltip: Check for desktop app updates via electron-updater.

nodes.label: URL & Export API
nodes.tooltip: openExternal URLs; export balances JSON.

nodes.label: window.api* Bridge
nodes.tooltip: Renderer-facing IPC surface: apiKeystore, apiHDWallet, apiMpc, apiCommonStorage, apiAppUpdate, apiUrl, apiExport, chain/asset/pools storages. Serialize BigInt with String().

nodes.label: App Provider Tree
nodes.tooltip: Nests Redux Provider + Wallet + all chain/protocol contexts + Router + Theme around AppView.

nodes.label: ViewRoutes / Router
nodes.tooltip: HashRouter routes: wallet, pools, swap, deposit, bonds, portfolio, history, settings, Vultisig create, Ledger chain select. WalletAuth guards protected routes.

nodes.label: Redux Store (limited)
nodes.tooltip: Slices: app (UI prefs), aggregator (protocol selection), gecko (prices). Not primary wallet state.

nodes.label: i18n (7 locales)
nodes.tooltip: Typed message keys; en + de, es, fr, hi, ko, ru. Always intl.formatMessage — never hardcode UI strings.

nodes.label: Theme Context
nodes.tooltip: Light/dark via Tailwind dark: tokens (text0/text0d, bg0/bg0d, turquoise).

nodes.label: WalletContext
nodes.tooltip: Exposes appWalletService, balances, keystore ops, ledger addresses to the component tree.

nodes.label: ChainContext
nodes.tooltip: Unified chain ops: swap$, deposit, withdraw, transfer, fees across all chains.

nodes.label: MidgardContext (THOR)
nodes.tooltip: THORChain Midgard: pools, actions/history, LP shares.

nodes.label: MayaMidgardContext
nodes.tooltip: MAYAChain Midgard pools/actions/shares.

nodes.label: ThorchainContext
nodes.tooltip: THORNode queries: mimir, inbound addresses, node infos, interact txs.

nodes.label: MayachainContext
nodes.tooltip: MAYANode queries and interact transactions.

nodes.label: ChainflipContext
nodes.tooltip: Chainflip asset support checks and swap channel helpers.

nodes.label: OneClickContext
nodes.tooltip: OneClick protocol asset support and tracking.

nodes.label: Per-Chain Contexts
nodes.tooltip: BTC, ETH, AVAX, BSC, ARB, BASE, LTC, BCH, DOGE, DASH, ADA, SOL, TRON, XRD, ZEC, XRP, SUI, COSMOS providers wrapping chain services.

nodes.label: appWalletService
nodes.tooltip: Single source of truth for wallet mode: Keystore | Standalone Ledger | Vultisig. Orchestrates mode switches, lastOpenedWallet, unlock lifecycle. UI must not bypass this.

nodes.label: keystoreService
nodes.tooltip: Encrypted mnemonic wallets: create, import phrase/keystore, unlock/lock, change password. Phrase never leaves renderer after unlock (in-memory clients).

nodes.label: vaultManager (Vultisig)
nodes.tooltip: Vultisig standalone mode: vault list/create/import, unlock phase machine, address cache. Talks to window.apiMpc only.

nodes.label: standaloneLedgerService
nodes.tooltip: Standalone Ledger mode: chain selection, address detection via apiHDWallet, no keystore phrase.

nodes.label: Wallet Balances Service
nodes.tooltip: Aggregates per-chain balances for keystore/ledger/vultisig into chainBalances$ / balancesState$.

nodes.label: Ledger Address Service
nodes.tooltip: Persisted ledger address refs (ledgers.json) for keystore+ledger hybrid accounts.

nodes.label: Wallet Transaction Helpers
nodes.tooltip: Wallet-level tx history and status helpers.

nodes.label: Enhanced Client Factory
nodes.tooltip: createEnhancedClient$: keystore client if phrase available, else read-only client for Ledger/Vultisig. Prevents hanging on O.none in standalone modes.

nodes.label: Client Utilities
nodes.tooltip: Shared address$, balances, fees, transfer, tx status factories used by all chain services.

nodes.label: Chain Orchestrator
nodes.tooltip: Cross-chain swap/deposit/withdraw/transfer routing, fee estimation, decimal resolution (tokenDecimalMap), memo-aware pool sends.

nodes.label: Decimal Resolution
nodes.tooltip: Order: CHAIN_DECIMAL_MAP → tokenDecimalMap → chain default → Midgard nativeDecimal (last resort).

nodes.label: Per-Chain Services
nodes.tooltip: One service folder per chain: common (client$), balances, fees, transaction. EVM chains share factory under services/evm/. Supported: THOR, MAYA, BTC, BCH, LTC, DOGE, DASH, ETH, AVAX, BSC, ARB, BASE, GAIA, ADA, SOL, TRON, XRP, XRD, ZEC, SUI.

nodes.label: EVM Service Factory
nodes.tooltip: Shared EVM client/balance/fee/tx factory for ETH, ARB, AVAX, BSC, BASE.

nodes.label: UTXO Helpers
nodes.tooltip: Coin control, UTXO Vultisig tx helpers, sendMax semantics for UTXO chains.

nodes.label: THOR Midgard Service
nodes.tooltip: Pools, actions, LP shares, pool address validation. Endpoints via Liquify (not retired Nine Realms hosts).

nodes.label: MAYA Midgard Service
nodes.tooltip: MAYA pools, actions, shares, validation.

nodes.label: THORChain Node Service
nodes.tooltip: THORNode client, balances, interact (bond/unbond/leave), tx tracking, mimir.

nodes.label: MAYAChain Node Service
nodes.tooltip: MAYANode client, balances, interact, fees.

nodes.label: Chainflip Service
nodes.tooltip: Chainflip SDK swaps: deposit channel + direct send; transaction tracking.

nodes.label: OneClick Service
nodes.tooltip: OneClick dynamic-asset protocol quotes/execution and tracking.

nodes.label: xchain Aggregator Slice
nodes.tooltip: Multi-protocol quote aggregation (THOR/MAYA/Chainflip/OneClick), protocol toggles, boost flags.

nodes.label: Renderer Storage Services
nodes.tooltip: User prefs: enabled chains, addresses, bond providers, nodes, pool watchlist — backed by main fileStore.

nodes.label: Price Level Service
nodes.tooltip: Price alerts / level monitoring.

nodes.label: App Service (network)
nodes.tooltip: Network selection (mainnet/stagenet), app-level observables.

nodes.label: useSwapQuote
nodes.tooltip: Fetches multi-protocol quotes via aggregator; protocol validation; selects best expected output.

nodes.label: useSwapFees
nodes.tooltip: Inbound fee, max amount, affiliate BPS (USD threshold), fee-adjusted amounts.

nodes.label: useSwapExecution
nodes.tooltip: Builds swap params and submits swap$ / swapCF$ / OneClick paths.

nodes.label: useSwapAddresses
nodes.tooltip: Source/target addresses and wallet type resolution (Ledger → Vultisig → Keystore priority).

nodes.label: useStreamingParams
nodes.tooltip: THOR swap modes: Rapid (interval=0), Streaming (user qty), Instant (qty=1).

nodes.label: memoHelper
nodes.tooltip: CRITICAL: getSwapMemo/updateMemo build affiliate segment (dx + bps). Do not use SDK swap path or affiliate revenue is silently dropped.

nodes.label: SwapView / Swap UI
nodes.tooltip: Swap page: asset pickers, quotes, streaming settings, confirmation modals (password/Ledger/Vultisig).

nodes.label: Deposit / Withdraw UI
nodes.tooltip: Symmetrical LP add/withdraw for THOR and MAYA pools.

nodes.label: Wallet Views
nodes.tooltip: Assets, send, create/import keystore, unlock, Ledger select, Vultisig create, interact, pool shares, TCY, trade assets.

nodes.label: Pools Views
nodes.tooltip: Pool overview, detail, active/pending pools.

nodes.label: Bonds View
nodes.tooltip: Node bonding UI for THOR/MAYA operators.

nodes.label: Portfolio View
nodes.tooltip: Aggregated portfolio value across chains and positions.

nodes.label: History Views
nodes.tooltip: Midgard action history and wallet tx history.

nodes.label: Confirmation Modals
nodes.tooltip: Password, Ledger, Vultisig confirmation modals dispatched by swap/deposit/send flows.

nodes.label: Shared UI Components
nodes.tooltip: Header, sidebar, uielements, settings, pool tables, assets filters — Tailwind + Headless UI.

nodes.label: xchainjs Libraries
nodes.tooltip: Chain clients, crypto, aggregator, midgard/query packages. App owns memos/affiliate; lib owns clients.

nodes.label: Vultisig SDK
nodes.tooltip: MPC vault and signing. Main process only.

nodes.label: Chainflip SDK
nodes.tooltip: Deposit channels and Chainflip swap quotes.

nodes.label: Midgard / Liquify APIs
nodes.tooltip: Pool state, history, inbound addresses. Use current Liquify providers — never reintroduce *.ninerealms.com.

nodes.label: THORNode / MAYANode
nodes.tooltip: Chain state, mimir constants, inbound addresses, tx observation.

nodes.label: Chain RPCs & Indexers
nodes.tooltip: UTXO/EVM/other RPC providers for balances, fees, broadcast. Keys via VITE_* env.

nodes.label: Ledger Hardware
nodes.tooltip: Physical device over USB HID.

flows.name: App Startup & Wallet Restore
flows.description: Electron boots main process, loads renderer, restores last opened wallet mode from storage.

steps.action: Start Electron, create BrowserWindow, register IPC handlers
Read common storage (lastOpenedWallet, network, etc.) via IPC
Load persisted JSON stores from disk
Restore Keystore | Ledger | Vultisig mode from lastOpenedWallet
Route to unlock / no-wallet / assets depending on state

flows.name: Keystore Unlock
flows.description: User unlocks encrypted mnemonic; chain clients receive phrase and emit addresses/balances.

steps.action: Decrypt keystore in renderer; set unlocked KeystoreState with phrase
client$ factories create xchain clients with phrase

flows.name: Standalone Ledger Connect
flows.description: User selects Ledger mode, picks chain, derives address over USB, loads balances via read-only client.

steps.action: HID transport + chain app derive address

flows.name: Vultisig Vault Create / Unlock
flows.description: MPC vault lifecycle via main-process SDK; renderer only uses apiMpc.

steps.action: Phase machine: creation | verification | locked | active
MPC keygen / password unlock / address derivation

flows.name: Multi-Chain Balance Loading
flows.description: Unified balances across enabled chains for current wallet mode.

flows.name: THORChain Swap
flows.description: Quote via aggregator, build affiliate memo, validate pool/node, send inbound tx, track status.

steps.action: Query THOR (+ other protocols); sort by expected out
Pool data / inbound for quote path
Sign+broadcast via keystore client | Ledger IPC | Vultisig MPC

flows.name: MAYAChain Swap
flows.description: Same pattern as THOR swap but MAYA midgard/node and CACAO-native validation rules.

flows.name: Chainflip Swap
flows.description: Direct send to Chainflip deposit channel; no THOR-style memo pool validation.

steps.action: sendTx$ to deposit address (no pool validate)

flows.name: OneClick Swap
flows.description: Dynamic-asset protocol route through OneClick service and tracking.

flows.name: Symmetrical Liquidity Deposit
flows.description: Add liquidity to THOR or MAYA pool (sym deposit).

steps.action: User sets asset amounts for pool
Or MAYA midgard: pool address + status
Estimate deposit fees; build deposit memos

flows.name: Liquidity Withdraw
flows.description: Withdraw symmetrical LP position via withdraw memo to pool/router.

flows.name: Send Transaction
flows.description: Plain transfer of asset to address, optional memo; mode-specific signing.

steps.action: Confirm with correct modal for WalletType
prepareTx + sign + broadcast (or IPC for Ledger/MPC)
If Ledger: apiHDWallet.sendTx; if Vultisig: apiMpc.sign

flows.name: EVM ERC20 Approve
flows.description: Approve router/spender before EVM pool deposit or swap when allowance insufficient.

flows.name: Node Bond / Interact
flows.description: THOR/MAYA node operator bond, unbond, leave via interact memos.

steps.action: Or mayachain interact.ts: build bond memo

flows.name: Transaction Status Tracking
flows.description: Post-submit observation across source chain and protocol outbounds.

steps.action: Or OneClick tracker if that protocol

flows.name: Browse Pools
flows.description: Load and display THOR/MAYA pool overview and detail.

walletModes.storage: Encrypted mnemonic in wallets.json via apiKeystore
Address refs in ledgers.json; standalone mode has no phrase

criticalInvariants: appWalletService is sole orchestrator; UI must not call keystore/vault/ledger services for mode questions
Affiliate fees live in app memoHelper (dx + bps), not SDK swap path
BigInt over IPC must be String(amount)
enhancedClient$ for Ledger/Vultisig — keystore client$ is O.none without phrase
Option is always truthy — use O.isNone/O.isSome
Do not reintroduce retired Nine Realms endpoints; use Liquify
Address resolution priority: Ledger → Vultisig → Keystore
sendMax: true only for UTXO chains
